CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFSERVLETPARAM

NEW IN KOLDFUSION 4.5

CFSERVLETPARAM tags go inside a CFSERVLET block. Each one passes a value (or, by reference, a variable) to the Java servlet. Since KoldFusion cannot run servlets, the tag does nothing on its own.

Category

Extensibility

Syntax

<CFSERVLETPARAM NAME="parameter_name"
    VALUE="value">

<CFSERVLETPARAM NAME="servlet_attribute_name"
    VARIABLE="variable_name"
    TYPE="INT/DOUBLE/BOOL/DATE/STRING">

Attributes

NAME
Required. Name of the parameter, or of the servlet attribute when passing by reference.
VALUE
Optional. Value passed as a request parameter.
VARIABLE
Optional. Name of a CFML variable passed by reference as a servlet attribute; changes made by the servlet come back into the variable.
TYPE
Optional, default "STRING". Java type of a VARIABLE: INT, DOUBLE, BOOL, DATE or STRING.

Usage

The tag is accepted anywhere and ignored; the enclosing CFSERVLET raises the error. See CFSERVLET for how to handle it.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Visitor = "Netscape 4.7 user">
<CFTRY>
  <CFSERVLET CODE="GuestCounterServlet">
    <CFSERVLETPARAM NAME="page" VALUE="cfservletparam.cfm">
    <CFSERVLETPARAM NAME="visitor" VARIABLE="Visitor" TYPE="STRING">
  </CFSERVLET>
  <CFCATCH TYPE="Any">
    <CFOUTPUT>
    <P>No servlet engine here, so the parameters went nowhere.<BR>
    <I>#CFCATCH.Detail#</I></P>
    <P>The variable passed by reference still says: <B>#Visitor#</B></P>
    </CFOUTPUT>
  </CFCATCH>
</CFTRY>

See also

CFSERVLET, CFHTTPPARAM, CFTRY
